contracts.protection_obligation: User-supplied local document paths must be filtered at the flow's registered start step so that paths resolving outside DOCUMENT_INPUT_DIR (path traversal), missing files, and files exceeding MAX_FILE_BYTES are rejected before the surviving paths are handed to downstream crew execution (merged from both reviewer opinions).
